dedupe_keys.name: ofcom wireless telegraphy register uk spectrum licences with technical parameters

description: The Wireless Telegraphy Register (WTR) records who is licensed to use specific radio frequencies or geographic areas in the United Kingdom and the technical parameters attached to those rights, and Ofcom publishes it under section 31 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006, also meeting its duties under the Environmental Information Regulations 2004. Published extracts come as CSV files split by licence product, such as fixed links and business radio, with an extract for all other licence types, plus register reports; the copy on the national data portal is a snapshot from October 2017 with reports from June to October 2017, and Ofcom aims to update the register quarterly on its own site. Records typically include the licensee, licence number and product, frequencies, locations as national grid references, antenna heights, powers and bandwidths. Coverage: the United Kingdom. Format and access: CSV extracts, free under the Open Government Licence. Caveats: the portal copy is old, so current data should come from Ofcom's site, which refused automated requests in this session; public safety and military assignments are not included. Simulation uses: locating microwave backhaul links and business radio sites for hazard exposure, and building fixed-link network graphs. Related records: Ofcom Sitefinder covers mobile base stations, and the Ofcom broadcast transmitter parameters cover TV and radio.
name: Ofcom Wireless Telegraphy Register: UK spectrum licences with technical parameters
